description: This is a PHP unit test class for the DataGroupDao's getDataGroupPermissions method, testing various scenarios of fetching data group permissions based on user roles and filter parameters.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetDataGroupPermissionsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the getDataGroupPermissions method of the DataGroupDao class under different user role scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixture data, and instantiates the DataGroupDao object.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEmptyParams
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of data group permissions with default empty parameters, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithAdmin
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval for an admin user role, asserting read and create permissions are true.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithEss
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval for an ESS user role, asserting only read permission is true.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithoutApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor role without including API data groups, expecting only basic permissions.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithApi
methods.description: Tests permissions for a supervisor role with API data groups included, expecting multiple permissions including delete.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsNotOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval when onlyAccessible is set to false, expecting multiple data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsWithOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Tests permissions retrieval when onlyAccessible is true, expecting a subset of data groups.
